item.title: Oh Yuusha yo, Itte Shimau to wa Nasakenai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luxury
  • 発売日: 2015-08-28
  • スコア: 7.56/10 (99 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おお勇者よ、イってしまうとは情けない！
  • 英語名: Oh Yuusha yo, Itte Shimau to wa Nasakenai!

别名

  • Oh! Yusya yo Ittesimautowa Nasakenai!

あらすじ

The hero Yushia and his party headed towards the demon lord’s castle to defeat him, but he fell into the demon lord’s sub-commander’s trap and was turned into a weak level 1 shota. When he reunited with his party members, he earnestly asked for their help in training him back up to regain his lost powers. But each of them wanted him for themselves and took full advantage of his unfortunate situation to make him their playtoy. Will he be able to endure their ecchi training? What will become of his quest to defeat the demon lord?

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2014-08-29
  • スコア: 7.7/10 (70 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔王のくせに生イキだっ！とろとろトロピカル！
  • 英語名: Maou no Kuse ni Namaiki da! Torotoro Tropical!

あらすじ

This is a fandisk for Maonama which takes place in between the first and second games. It’s split into three parts: the maou chapter at the beach, the maid chapter with mock weddings, and the another story for subchara-turned-heroine Lucifuges. The system is the same as the two previous games.

item.title: Maou no Kuse ni Namaiki da! 2 ~Kondo wa Seisen da!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luxury
  • 発売日: 2013-10-25
  • スコア: 7.76/10 (92 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔王のくせに生イキだっ！2 ～今度は性戦だ！～
  • 英語名: Maou no Kuse ni Namaiki da! 2 Kondo wa Seisen da!

别名

  • 魔王のくせに生イキだっ！ ＮＥＰ特別公開版～ねっぷねぷにしてやんよ 1～ 4 ～

あらすじ

This is the sequel to Maou no Kuse ni Namaiki da!. The 30-year old NEET Kuranosuke unified the demon world, but didn’t end up being the great maou. He lives peacefully with the maous in the human world, but one day an angel came to his room (via his monitor again) and he ended up being caught in a strife between two heavenly powers, one intent on destroying the demon world and the other with a pacifist approach. Somehow, he was able to solve it with the help of the maous. But then the two angel faction leaders, as well as the angel from before, came to stay at his house too!? It seems like they’ve taken a liking to him after his help from before.

item.title: Trouble@Vampire! ~Ano Ko wa Ore no Goshujin-sama~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luxury
  • 発売日: 2009-10-30
  • スコア: 6.890000000000001/10 (27 人評価)
  • 日本語名: とらぶる＠ヴァンパイア！～あの娘は俺のご主人さま～
  • 英語名: Trouble@Vampire! Ano Ko wa Ore no Goshujin-sama

别名

  • That girl is my master

あらすじ

Ritsu is a new teacher at a prestigious ‘classical’ all-girls school. One day, he saves his students by protecting them from some magic, but ended up getting severely hurt. When he woke up, he saw a girl named Shion, who actually is a vampire. She called him her servant since she had bit him to save him from death after he had lost too much blood.
